sources.label: Find a Tender, Procurement Act award notices naming their framework (relatedProcesses), OCDS

matchRule: A call-off appears ONLY where its own Find a Tender award notice names the framework by ocid (relatedProcesses, relationship 'framework'). Nothing is matched on title, supplier or CPV. hubFramework is set only where the framework's ocid equals a Hub framework award record, or one of its Find a Tender notice ids equals an NHS Supply Chain brief's reference exactly.
healthRule: The call-off's buyer, or the framework's own buyer, names NHS, an Integrated Care Board, a Health Board, Health and Social Care, the Department of Health, UKHSA or Supply Chain Coordination; or a CPV on the call-off begins 33 or 851.
supplierNote: Supplier names are copied exactly as the notice publishes them.

coverage.note: Procurement Act notices only (from 24/02/2025). Call-offs under older frameworks and below-threshold call-offs on Contracts Finder publish no framework link and are not here. 0 call-off(s) wait for their framework to be read from Find a Tender.
